calls.function: multicall((address to, bytes data, uint256 value, bool skipRevert, bytes32 callbackHash)[] bundle)

call.function: claim(address account, address reward, uint256 claimable, bytes32[] proof)

claimable.free: the cumulative amount in the Merkle leaf: the distributor reverts unless the proof hashes it into the root; the effects require the Safe to get a positive amount of the card's token and nothing else

free.proof: a Merkle proof: the distributor reverts unless it proves the leaf (account, reward, claimable) against the root

trailer.why: the Morpho app appends a 4-byte timestamp and a 4-byte origin tag; multicall reads only its one argument

calls.merge: the Morpho app claims every reward token in one multicall, one bundle item per token
